method: Temporary consumer-local proc-macro renderer copy substituted a tracing printer; compiler/options/predicate/prefix modules referenced original shared sources read-only. Tracing printer invoked unchanged compiler::compile, preserving and serializing each rejected Structures Program. Scaffolding removed afterward.

CQ_GPU_BUILD_TYPE.missing_fact: Recorded compatible device index representation for a composite key. Existing Structures records a one-level cq_storage::HashIndex with multiple columns, not a supported SortedRun / PrefixRun or certified AdaptiveKeySet.
CQ_GPU_BUILD_TYPE.why_rewrites_leave_it: sorted_runs only retypes a single stored integral key and rejects owned/computed keys; prefix_runs only handles multi-level Trie, not one-level composite HashIndex.
CQ_GPU_BUILD_TYPE.minimal_fix_required: A checked representation/physical rewrite that exposes an integral singleton prefix and preserves every remaining composite-key equality as an exact residual predicate, then records a supported device run. Simply renaming HashIndex to SortedRun is invalid: the printer also requires a singleton first level.

CQ_GPU_OPAQUE_BIND.missing_fact: A certified closed host scalar capture classification for typed i64 meta fields; current GPU Bind proof accepts only copied relational dereferences or literals, not field expressions.
CQ_GPU_OPAQUE_BIND.minimal_fix_required: Extend the checked Bind fragment with explicitly certified, rule-independent typed Copy scalar captures; evaluate once on the host and pass encoded scalar parameters. Keep arbitrary Rust/rule-dependent expressions rejected. DefUsedAddr1 and DefUsedAddr4 also contain unsupported recorded HashIndex builds, which remain after fixing captures.
